patch.value: Replace hand-built api doubles in extension tests with the SDK activation harness

pm-changelog never carried the defineExtension any-shim so it fell outside the 2026.7.26 typed-authoring rollout, but its extension tests still built api doubles by hand and cast them through Parameters of extension.activate. Those doubles verify the extension against a locally captured object rather than the host contract, and skip the capability governance pm applies at activation.

Registration, flag and renderer-ownership assertions read from the real activation result; Handler-invoking tests run through runRegisteredCommandForTest; The legacy two-argument runtime test keeps a documented double because it simulates a different host version; Full suite passes and the extension is functionally verified in a real workspace

Migrated five of six hand-built api doubles onto activateExtensionForTest and runRegisteredCommandForTest, with the capability grant read from manifest.json. The sixth is retained and documented because its subject is the legacy two-argument registerExporter host, which the harness cannot simulate.
Extension surface verified against the real host contract under manifest capability governance, with no behavior change.
179/179 tests pass; typecheck clean; functional install confirmed pm changelog generate and pm changelog export --format json both run against a real workspace.
